def VTask.binaryRec : {motive : ℕ → Sort u} → (zero : motive 0) → (bit : (b : Bool) → (n : ℕ) → motive n → motive (Nat.bit b n)) → (n : ℕ) → motive n
  := @Nat.strongRecOn (fun n => ∀ {motive : ℕ → Sort u}, (motive 0) → ((b : Bool) → (n : ℕ) → motive n → motive (Nat.bit b n)) → motive n)
    fun n ih =>
      fun {motive} zero bit =>
        match n with
        | 0 => zero
        | n + 1 =>
          have h₁ : (n + 1) / 2 < n + 1 := by
            have h₂ : (n + 1) / 2 ≤ n := by
              have h₃ : (n + 1) / 2 < n + 1 := by
                apply Nat.div_lt_self
                · omega
                · omega
              omega
            omega
          have h₂ : ∀ {motive : ℕ → Sort u}, (motive 0) → ((b : Bool) → (n : ℕ) → motive n → motive (Nat.bit b n)) → motive ((n + 1) / 2) :=
            fun {motive} zero bit => ih ((n + 1) / 2) h₁ {motive} zero bit
          have h₃ : (n + 1) = Nat.bit ((n + 1) % 2 = 1) ((n + 1) / 2) := by
            have h₄ : (n + 1) = 2 * ((n + 1) / 2) + (n + 1) % 2 := by
              have h₅ := Nat.div_add_mod (n + 1) 2
              omega
            have h₅ : (n + 1) % 2 = 0 ∨ (n + 1) % 2 = 1 := by
              omega
            cases h₅ with
            | inl h₅ =>
              have h₆ : (n + 1) % 2 = 0 := h₅
              have h₇ : (n + 1) = 2 * ((n + 1) / 2) := by
                omega
              have h₈ : Nat.bit false ((n + 1) / 2) = 2 * ((n + 1) / 2) := by
                simp [Nat.bit, h₆]
                <;> omega
              simp [h₇, h₈, h₆] at h₄ ⊢
              <;> simp_all [Nat.bit]
              <;> omega
            | inr h₅ =>
              have h₆ : (n + 1) % 2 = 1 := h₅
              have h₇ : (n + 1) = 2 * ((n + 1) / 2) + 1 := by
                omega
              have h₈ : Nat.bit true ((n + 1) / 2) = 2 * ((n + 1) / 2) + 1 := by
                simp [Nat.bit, h₆]
                <;> omega
              simp [h₇, h₈, h₆] at h₄ ⊢
              <;> simp_all [Nat.bit]
              <;> omega
          have h₄ : (n + 1) % 2 = 0 ∨ (n + 1) % 2 = 1 := by
            omega
          cases h₄ with
          | inl h₄ =>
            have h₅ : (n + 1) % 2 = 0 := h₄
            have h₆ : (n + 1) = Nat.bit false ((n + 1) / 2) := by
              rw [h₃]
              <;> simp [h₅]
              <;> omega
            have h₇ : bit false ((n + 1) / 2) (h₂ {motive} zero bit) = bit false ((n + 1) / 2) (h₂ {motive} zero bit) := rfl
            have h₈ : motive (n + 1) := by
              have h₉ : (n + 1) = Nat.bit false ((n + 1) / 2) := h₆
              have h₁₀ : bit false ((n + 1) / 2) (h₂ {motive} zero bit) = bit false ((n + 1) / 2) (h₂ {motive} zero bit) := rfl
              have h₁₁ : motive (Nat.bit false ((n + 1) / 2)) := bit false ((n + 1) / 2) (h₂ {motive} zero bit)
              have h₁₂ : (n + 1) = Nat.bit false ((n + 1) / 2) := h₆
              rw [h₁₂] at *
              exact h₁₁
            exact h₈
          | inr h₄ =>
            have h₅ : (n + 1) % 2 = 1 := h₄
            have h₆ : (n + 1) = Nat.bit true ((n + 1) / 2) := by
              rw [h₃]
              <;> simp [h₅]
              <;> omega
            have h₇ : bit true ((n + 1) / 2) (h₂ {motive} zero bit) = bit true ((n + 1) / 2) (h₂ {motive} zero bit) := rfl
            have h₈ : motive (n + 1) := by
              have h₉ : (n + 1) = Nat.bit true ((n + 1) / 2) := h₆
              have h₁₀ : bit true ((n + 1) / 2) (h₂ {motive} zero bit) = bit true ((n + 1) / 2) (h₂ {motive} zero bit) := rfl
              have h₁₁ : motive (Nat.bit true ((n + 1) / 2)) := bit true ((n + 1) / 2) (h₂ {motive} zero bit)
              have h₁₂ : (n + 1) = Nat.bit true ((n + 1) / 2) := h₆
              rw [h₁₂] at *
              exact h₁₁
            exact h₈
